answer_1.quote: The goal of this work is to benchmark different architectures in terms of inference speed/translation quality trade-off and to identify the best combination for multilingual NMT.

answer_2.quote: We report average test BLEU scores into English (→EN, 19 directions), from English (←EN, 19 directions) and outside of English (/ EN, 342 directions). We also compute the decoding speed in Words Per Second (WPS) when translating... We also report chrF scores and results on more models in Appendix Table.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to compare the English-centric Big 6-6 and Big 12-2 models. It is done by certified professionals who are proficient in both the source and target language. We use bilingual direct assessment (DA), where raters have to evaluate the adequacy and fluency of each translation on a 0-5 scale given the source sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate adequacy and fluency on a 0-5 scale for each translation given the source sentence.
